issues.description: default_raise() sentinel kept as required-field marker after kw_only landed; contract is now misleading.
issues.detail: With kw_only=True universally available, required fields can simply omit defaults. Retaining field(default_factory=default_raise) as a 'required' marker weakens the supertype postcondition: instantiating without that arg now raises RuntimeError at construction time instead of TypeError at the call site. The ADT promise (required-arg semantics) should be expressed by the dataclass machinery, not a runtime trapdoor.

issues.description: Ruff UP007/UP035/UP045 globally ignored, deferring the Union -> | migration the PR description promises.
issues.detail: The contract stated in the PR ('Union types will soon not be supported') is contradicted by ruff.toml ignoring exactly those rules. This leaves the codebase in a two-dialect state with no enforced boundary or tracking issue referenced. Either land the migration or scope the ignore to specific paths with a TODO link; a blanket ignore is SPEC-MISSING.

issues.description: default_default fallback removal in option() narrows the contract without documenting it.
issues.detail: Previously option() returned a field with default=None on <3.10 and MISSING on >=3.10. Now it is unconditionally MISSING. Callers that relied on the implicit None default on older interpreters will see a different exception shape. Acceptable since 3.9 is dropped, but worth a one-line docstring stating the new precondition: callers must supply default= explicitly or accept MISSING.

issues.description: test-install-scripts.yml runs 'dnf search python3.12' inside the install path; diagnostic noise in a contract step.
issues.detail: The Amazon/Rocky preparation steps now perform a 'dnf search' before install. Search output is not part of the install postcondition and will mask real failures if python3.12 is renamed or unavailable. Drop the search or move it behind an explicit availability check so the step's contract (python3.12 installed) is what fails when it fails.

issues.description: Stale comment in wallet_request_types still references '< 3.10 compatibility' after compatibility shim removed.
issues.detail: The comment block above TransactionEndpointRequest explains default_factory=default_raise as a <3.10 workaround. With kw_only_dataclass deleted, that rationale no longer holds; the pattern is now load-bearing only because default_raise is still used as a required-field sentinel. Either remove default_raise (preferred) or update the comment to state the real invariant.

review.summary: The Python 3.9 removal is mechanically clean and the kw_only consolidation is a real simplification of the ADT surface (one dataclass contract instead of two version-conditional ones). The main contract concern is that default_raise() survives as a required-field sentinel even though kw_only=True now lets the dataclass express required-ness natively; that weakens the postcondition (RuntimeError at construct time instead of TypeError at the call boundary) and should be removed in a follow-up. The blanket ruff ignore for UP007/UP035/UP045 contradicts the stated migration direction and leaves the Union-vs-pipe contract unspecified. Workflow-side changes are fine but the added 'dnf search' is diagnostic noise inside a step whose contract is 'install succeeded.' No LSP violations introduced; one LEAKY-ABSTRACTION (default_raise) carried over from before.
